data.content_ref: inline:The claimed recursion is non-substantive: applying the same intermediate-state verifiability criterion to the evaluator's reliability judgment merely re-applies a pass/fail test at one higher level without producing a convergence guarantee. If the meta-evaluator's own reliability claim can itself be genuine or mere compliance, the recursion adds an infinite regress rather than a diagnostic — it never bottoms out in a ground-truth signal, so 'shares mechanism' is trivial inheritance, not a substantive relation.
